desc: Derive the counting formulas for the three cases (middle value appears 1, 2, or 3 times in the subsequence) in terms of left/right frequency maps, including the "pairs with both equal to some other value" corrections.
Design helper structures: incremental left/right frequency maps with running sumC2 aggregates while sweeping i.
Implement the per-index aggregation combining left-pair and right-pair counts per case (k=1..4), with careful modular arithmetic (MOD = 10**9+7).
Handle edge cases: values appearing many times, negative/large values (hash maps / compression), and verify against the three examples plus brute force on small random arrays.
Write final solution in the starter code with O(n²) worst-case complexity, and add brief comments explaining each case.
